verdict.line: You lose if you let Ornn get free Volcanic Rupture pokes off while you have nothing to punish; you win by walking him down once Counter Strike is up and he's thrown a cooldown.

brief.thesis: This is a dead-even 48% matchup over 1016 games where neither side has a structural edge — Ornn's Q (Volcanic Rupture) poke and Brittle setup trade against your ability to just dodge his entire kit with E (Counter Strike). The lane is decided by who plays cooldowns better, not by champion identity.

theirWindow.when: after he lands Q poke, pillar forming
theirWindow.what: He has a magma pillar incoming and Q on cooldown (9-7s) — he can still punish a greedy all-in with W (Bellows Breath) into Brittle, so don't walk into melee range right after eating a Q unless his W is also down.

yourWindow.when: his Q and W are both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: This is your all-in window. Leap Strike in, pop W (Empower) on the engage auto, and hold E (Counter Strike) for when he tries to trade back — it dodges his basic attacks entirely and stuns him on the exit, which is exactly the OP.GG tip: block his auto after Brittle lands.

start.why: 46.1% win rate over 638 games and the clear majority pick (53.1%) — the extra AD and sustain let you contest his Q poke trades without falling behind on health.

boots.why: 47% win rate, 54.8% pick — the tenacity matters because Brittle setups into his W and R chains want to slow/root you, and MR helps against his magic-damage Q and ultimate.

core.why: The highest-performing path (55.4% over 65 games) — the burst-on-proc and attack speed let you win short trades before Ornn's Q comes off cooldown again.
Follows Trinity in the top build path — the on-hit proc and shield reward you for engaging exactly when his cooldowns are down.
Caps the top path at 9.8% pick — lets you dive his R elemental redirect or his all-in and survive the burst window.

situational.when: he's building toward a long siege and you need to survive extended trades
the game goes long and you want sustain in extended skirmishes (Dusk and Dawn path, 60.9% over 23 games)
he starts building pure tank and you need the % current health shred

runes.keystoneWhy: 46.1% win rate at 28.1% pick — the ramping attack speed rewards exactly the extended-trade pattern this matchup wants, especially once you land Leap Strike and start stacking autos through his Brittle window.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is the highest win rate combo (48.3% over 40.9% pick) — Teleport lets you reset after losing early poke exchanges and still make the 6-8 level spike relevant on the map.

playing.title: Hold E for his engage, not yours
playing.detail: Counter Strike dodges all incoming basic attacks and stuns on activation — save it for when Ornn commits to an all-in rather than opening with it, since using it offensively wastes the dodge window.

playing.title: Track his Q cooldown after every poke
playing.detail: Volcanic Rupture is 9-7s on cooldown depending on rank — count it out loud if you have to. A landed Q means you have a 7-9 second window where his main poke tool is gone.

playing.title: Don't Leap Strike into his W charge-up
playing.detail: Bellows Breath applies Brittle on the final gout of flame — if you see him winding it up, holding Leap Strike until after it resolves avoids eating bonus damage while Brittle.

playing.title: All-in during his R recast window
playing.detail: Call of the Forge God requires Ornn to be near his elemental to redirect it — if he's chasing the elemental on your flank instead of in lane, that's dead time to shove or trade freely.

playing.title: Use R to win extended fights, not to start them
playing.detail: Relentless Assault has no cooldown and scales off consecutive attacks — it's already active in any prolonged trade, so don't think of it as a cooldown to save, think of it as a reason to stay in extended exchanges rather than poke-and-leave.

playing.title: Empower the engage auto, not a random one
playing.detail: W's bonus damage and small AoE hit are wasted on a free auto in neutral spacing — time it into your Leap Strike landing so the splash damage actually catches him before he can reposition.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1, 1016-game sample for this head-to-head); the cooldown timings, ability behavior, and tactical reasoning about when to trade are my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Use Counter Strike [E] to block Ornn’s basic attack after being Brittle.
